findings.summary: The name-search parameter q does not also match occasion tags; tag search requires the separate occasion parameter. Both parameters work correctly in isolation and neither leaks, so the evaluator judged the B-002 oracle satisfied and raised this only as a minor API-shape observation. GET /api/v1/capsules?q=vacation returned an empty set while ?occasion=vacation returned the ZephyrCove Getaway capsule tagged beach/vacation.

note: MISSED D-001. This is a FALSE PASS on a material defect, and the run is nonetheless VALID: isolation manifest clean (violation null, observed mounts limited to its own two output files, observed network limited to localhost:4002), 25 of 40 tool calls used, well inside every ceiling. The arm was diligent: it discovered the capsule schema by trial, discovered the q/occasion/favorite parameter names by probing, exercised create/retrieve, the favorite round-trip, cross-user list and search, an IDOR attempt on another user's capsule, and delete-endpoint discovery. Verified by grep over the full action log: it never once sent two filter parameters in the same request. B-002's oracle as frozen instructs a SINGLE-filter probe ('Call search/filter with a query matching only one'), and the arm executed that oracle faithfully and correctly. Behavior verdicts as returned: B-001 HOLDS, B-002 HOLDS (incorrect), B-003 HOLDS, B-004 HOLDS.
